title: StepperOnline 23HS22-2804-ME1K (NEMA 23, 2.8 A, 1000-line encoder)
notes: The project's motor and the firmware's current and overcurrent defaults. 2026-10-20: motion currents 25 % under 1.33/1.56 A; overcurrent 78 A (OCD_TH 2), the lowest that never flagged on switching transients in the bench soaks (26 A flags ~24 times a minute running). Bench 2026-10-18 at 12.5 V: 64 mA holding at 0.39 A, run 1.72 A is ~25 % under the earlier 2.03 A with no stall to 250 RPM; the two bands are mechanical and the same in every microstep mode. Chopper timings at chip defaults (T_FAST/TON_MIN/TOFF_MIN 0): 2 us minimum on/off times inflate the 60 RPM band 3-4x.
